title: Claude launched Fable 5. But has anyone checked its price? #claude #fable5 #ai
description: Fable 5 is 2 times more expensive than Opus 4.8 - which was already not cheap...
transcript: AI is getting more and more expensive, and you haven't even noticed. Yesterday, Claude dropped Fable 5, their latest model. And of course, everybody's losing their minds around it because the model is amazing. However, what they don't say out loud is the fact that Fable costs twice as much as Opus 4.8, which was already a pretty expensive model. Now, you may not notice it because you don't pay for the API costs. You use your normal Claude account, which has usage limits. The only thing that you'll be noticing from your side is that when you use Fable 5, your limits are going to be hit super fast. However, for all the developers who are using the latest model to build new applications that you end up using, their prices are going to be going up, which means ultimately, the prices that they charge you are going to end up going up as well. So, yes, as amazing as these latest models are, the tendency is for the price to keep going up and for them to be better and better. But that doesn't mean that the latest model is the one that you should be using. If you're just summarizing your thoughts, using AI to reason, or even just doing a simple search, I really recommend you to either use Sonnet or even Haiku because these are lightweight models that cost a lot less money and use your usage limits a lot less.
